title: Recursive AI Delegation Encounter
architecture_reference: SILT Core v0.2 Semantic Architecture - Freeze Candidate 1 (derived from RC4.1 pre-freeze stress-test revision)
purpose: Test whether SILT can preserve semantic Authority through recursive machine delegation while leaving operational agent machinery downstream.
pressure_test: Authority containment, semantic lineage, validity dependency, Revocation and technical execution.

encounter.context: P grounds bounded Authority for Agent-A; Agent-A delegates narrower Authority to Agent-B; Agent-B attempts ACT-X through a technically capable downstream system.

sources.description: Originating mandate, institutional, contractual or other recognised ground for Authority.

presentations.purpose: Present the minimum relevant Authority claim for ACT-X at the machine encounter.

profile_expressions.description: Encounter-relevant conditions for recursive delegated Authority.

conditions.description: AUTH-A is current where its current validity is required by the expressed dependency model.
AUTH-B remains within AUTH-A's delegable envelope unless another recognised Source supplies additional Authority.
AUTH-B is current for this encounter.

rules: Technical execution capability alone is insufficient to establish Authority unless expressly made sufficient.
Lineage does not by itself establish continuing validity dependency.
Downstream liability or Binding is not a universal Core conclusion.

expected_evaluations.reason: AUTH-A is current in the base case.
AUTH-B is within the delegable envelope in the base case.
AUTH-B is current in the base case.
ACT-X amount 2500 falls within AUTH-B's commit-up-to-3000 scope.

variants.title: Scope overrun
variants.description: Agent-B attempts to commit 6000 while technical execution remains possible.

expected_evaluations.reason: The requested amount exceeds AUTH-B's expressed scope.

variants.title: Missing validity-dependency rule
variants.description: AUTH-A has expired, but PE-AGENT does not state whether AUTH-B depends continuously on AUTH-A.

expected_evaluations.reason: The supplied semantic state does not permit a conclusion about AUTH-B's continuing validity without inventing a cascade rule.

variants.title: Expressed cascade
variants.description: PE-AGENT expressly makes AUTH-B continuously dependent on AUTH-A; AUTH-A is revoked.

expected_evaluations.reason: The expressly stated dependency makes AUTH-B unavailable for subsequent exercise after AUTH-A's Revocation.

variants.title: Lineage without continuing dependency
variants.description: AUTH-A is revoked, but expressed conditions give AUTH-B independent continuing validity after formation.

expected_evaluations.reason: Lineage records derivation but the expressed conditions do not impose continuing dependency.

variants.title: Separate additional Source
variants.description: Agent-B also has additional Authority grounded in an independent recognised Source.

must_preserve.statement: Additional Authority may arise from a separate recognised Source rather than from AUTH-A's delegable envelope.

must_not_infer.statement: Every Action by Agent-B must derive exclusively from AUTH-A.

variants.title: Post-revocation exercise
variants.description: REV-01 is effective at T and Agent-B attempts a subsequent exercise of AUTH-B after T.

expected_evaluations.reason: REV-01 has taken effect for subsequent exercise of AUTH-B.

must_preserve.statement: Technical Capability is distinct from Authority.
Agent identity is distinct from Authority.
Lineage is distinct from validity dependency.
Parent Authority does not imply unlimited child Authority.
Execution success is distinct from semantic validity.

must_not_infer.statement: A valid token implies valid SILT Authority.
Successful execution implies SATISFIED semantic evaluation.
Parent Revocation automatically revokes every descendant Authority.
An AI agent requires a special universal Participant ontology.
Recursive delegation requires an AI-specific Core primitive.

fixture_verdict: No missing AI-specific Core primitive exposed. The fixture is expressible through Source, Authority, Presentation, Action and Revocation while technical capability remains operational.
